register: ATHENA Micro-skill Research Source Register — Original 70

sources.title: Spacing and retrieval practice guide
sources.fit: Directly supports spaced learning and active retrieval in classroom learning; recommends adaptation to learner and content context.

sources.title: Organizing Instruction and Study to Improve Student Learning
sources.publisher: Institute of Education Sciences / What Works Clearinghouse
sources.fit: Recommendations include spacing, worked examples, graphics plus verbal descriptions, concrete/abstract connections, quizzes and deep explanatory questions. Evidence strength varies by recommendation.

sources.title: The science of effective learning with spacing and retrieval practice
sources.publisher: Nature Reviews Psychology; Carpenter, Pan & Butler
sources.fit: Synthesizes spacing and retrieval practice across learning contexts; supports strategy selection but not every individual micro-skill.

sources.title: Teaching the science of learning
sources.publisher: Cognitive Research: Principles and Implications; Weinstein, Madan & Sumeracki
sources.fit: Reviews spacing, interleaving, retrieval, elaboration, concrete examples and dual coding.

sources.title: A Meta-Analysis of the Effectiveness and Boundary Conditions of Retrieval Practice, Distributed Practice, and Interleaved Practice in Authentic School Classrooms
sources.publisher: Educational Psychology Review; Ruitenburg et al.
sources.fit: 53 studies, 7,303 participants; average effects reported for retrieval, spacing and interleaving, with moderators. Do not generalize effects to unrelated physical or interpersonal tasks.

sources.title: Motor skill learning and performance: a review of influential factors
sources.fit: Reviews observational practice, attentional focus, feedback and self-controlled practice as factors in motor-skill learning.

sources.title: Self-Controlled Feedback and Behavioral Outcomes in Motor Skill Learning: A Meta-Analysis
sources.fit: 29 studies / 1,147 participants; self-controlled feedback effects are mixed across learning phases. Supports cautious feedback design, not a universal rule.

sources.title: 7 Ways to Listen Better
sources.fit: Practical active-listening behaviours; useful instruction, not a controlled efficacy study.

sources.title: Evaluation and Feedback
sources.fit: Behaviour-focused, respectful feedback and limiting feedback to a small number of actionable points.

sources.title: Voice Disorders: Practice Portal
sources.fit: Voice health guidance: avoid shouting/talking over noise, hydrate, use moderate volume and seek professional care for persistent problems.

sources.title: Secure Our World: Multifactor Authentication tip sheet
sources.fit: MFA activation and account protection; pair with password-manager and phishing guidance.

sources.title: Git status documentation
sources.fit: Defines working-tree/index/HEAD state and status output; appropriate for MS-05-005.

sources.title: Git diff documentation
sources.fit: Defines comparisons between working tree, index and commits; appropriate for safe inspection practice.

sources.title: Civic Online Reasoning / lateral reading instructional basis
sources.publisher: Stanford History Education Group / Digital Inquiry Group (referenced via research and instructional materials)
sources.fit: Lateral reading asks who is behind information, what evidence exists and what other sources say; useful for source evaluation.

sources.title: Get directions & show routes in Google Maps
sources.fit: Route planning across walking and transit modes; explicitly tells users to remain aware and follow actual signs/traffic rules.

sources.title: Smartphone photography
sources.fit: Composition, gridlines, rule of thirds, light, shadow and phone-camera fundamentals.

sources.title: Professional-looking smartphone photography
sources.fit: Natural light, composition, focus/exposure adjustments and phone camera modes.

sources.title: Child Activity: An Overview
sources.publisher: US Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (CDC)
sources.fit: For ages 6–17: 60+ minutes daily moderate-to-vigorous activity, including aerobic, muscle- and bone-strengthening activity. This is population guidance, not an individual training prescription.

sources.title: First Aid Steps
sources.fit: Scene safety, initial impression, consent/PPE, call emergency services and care within training level.

sources.title: Bangladesh Police hotline numbers
sources.fit: Lists 999 as national emergency service and other hotlines. Verify periodically before use; emergency numbers can change.

sources.title: National Emergency Service 999
sources.fit: Describes 999 as police, fire and ambulance emergency service available day and night.

sources.title: Electrical Fire Safety Checklist
sources.fit: Warning signs include damaged/frayed cords, hot or buzzing outlets and loose plugs; teach recognition and escalation, not repair.

sources.title: Hand and Power Tools
sources.publisher: US Occupational Safety and Health Administration (OSHA)
sources.fit: Tool inspection, guards, PPE, securing work, keeping bystanders away and removing damaged tools from use.

sources.title: Hazard Communication: Appendix C — Allocation of Label Elements
sources.publisher: US Occupational Safety and Health Administration (OSHA)
sources.fit: Explains product identifier, signal word, pictograms, hazard statements and precautionary statements. Local label law may differ.

sources.title: Choosing and Using Fire Extinguishers
sources.fit: Decision checklist: alarm/call, small contained fire, escape route, ability and smoke safety; says young children should not use extinguishers.

sources.title: Cuts and grazes
sources.fit: Basic wound literacy and escalation red flags; local clinical guidance should take precedence.

sources.title: CPR and First Aid Course Catalog
sources.fit: Course discovery and distinction between non-credentialed education and instructor-led/blended skills practice.

sources.title: Emergency Action Plan: Fight or Flee?
sources.publisher: US Occupational Safety and Health Administration (OSHA)
sources.fit: Only very small/incipient fires under strict conditions; evacuation and alerting take priority.

sources.title: How Do You Ensure That a Tape Measure Is Accurate?
sources.publisher: US National Institute of Standards and Technology (NIST)
sources.fit: Measurement accuracy, repeatability, reference standards and uncertainty; supports measurement literacy.
